'''Archmage Trelane'''<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|32|Malin's Request}}</ref> was once a studying wizard in the [[Tower of Arathor]]. There he created a defense system that call [[Summoned Guardian]]s for help when using a prepared [[Enchanted Agate|gem]]. It seems that this wasn't enough as he fled [[Stromgarde (kingdom)|Stromgarde]] not long ago. He is the original master of [[Archmage Malin]], who sent [[Skuerto]] to recover some of Trelane's belongings from the [[ogre]] controlled part of [[Stromgarde Keep]].

According to {{questlong|Alliance|39|Malin's Request (2)|Malin's Request}}, Trelane is located in [[Stormwind City]].

==Possessions==
Trelane left several items in the tower, all named after Trelane. They are:
*[[Trelane's Phylactery]] in [[Trelane's Footlocker]]
*[[Trelane's Orb]] in [[Trelane's Chest]]
*[[Trelane's Ember Agate]] in [[Trelane's Lockbox]].
*[[Trelane's Wand of Invocation]] held by [[Kor'gresh Coldrage]], which enables the wielder to cast frost spells, most notably [http://thottbot.com/s4320 Trelane's Freezing Touch].<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|39|Wand over Fist}}</ref><ref>[[Kor'gresh Coldrage#Abilities]]</ref>
